_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Airworthiness Qualification Implementation Plan
summary: Documents the detailed approach to implementing Navy standards to obtain airworthiness certifications for a system.
use_relationship:
The purpose of the Airworthiness Qualification Implementation Plan (AQIP) is to document the detailed approach to implementing Navy standards to obtain airworthiness certifications.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work/Performance Work Statement.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Contents
preparation_instructions.content: The AQIP describe the project, system details, and the airworthiness approach. The AQIP shall be completed in accordance with Airworthiness Bulletin (AWB)-003, "Airworthiness Basis Management" and NAVAIR Instruction 13034.1G, "Airworthiness and Cybersecurity Safety Policies for Air Vehicles and Aircraft Systems." The AQIP shall include:

children.title: Data Identifiers
children.content: The AQIP shall contain information needed to maintain configuration control (e.g., date, revision, and managing office) throughout the life of the system.

children.title: System Description
children.content: The AQIP shall include information to identify the system(s) being certified. It shall also contain a list of previous certifications obtained, either civil or military.

children.title: A summary of modifications required to convert
children.content: A summary of modifications required to convert the previously certified basic aircraft to the as-delivered configuration shall be included. The previous certification authority and the applicable type certification basis shall be identified.

children.title: Airworthiness Approach
children.content: The AQIP shall include the airworthiness approach in accordance with AWB-003. This shall include a schedule of all airworthiness related activities and the approach to maintain airworthiness and substantiating data throughout the air system's service life. The Airworthiness Approach shall detail the roles and responsibilities of the prime contractor and subcontractors.

children.title: Contact Information
children.content: The AQIP shall include the responsible engineer(s) for the contractor and all subcontractors listing the name, phone number, email for each. The listing shall be in contractor format and shall provide points of contact for each airworthiness certification criteria. This information shall be separate from the plan.

children.title: Airworthiness Qualification Matrix
children.content: The AQIP shall identify the impacted criteria in an airworthiness qualification matrix using MIL-HDBK-516C. The qualification matrix shall identify the criteria along with the applicability and method of compliance for each criterion.

children.title: Configuration-specific Airworthiness Qualification
children.content: The AQIP shall identify the plan to ensure airworthiness qualification for each aircraft configuration.

children.title: Continued Airworthiness
children.content: The AQIP shall define the process for maintaining airworthiness through the operation and maintenance of the aircraft during the duration of the contract.

children.title: DD-250, Acceptance and Transfer Inspection
children.content: The AQIP shall document the contractor's role in aircraft acceptance and transfer to include aircraft custodianship, custodianship transfer, and acceptance inspections.

children.title: Glossary and Acronyms
children.content: The AQIP shall clearly identify and define all acronyms used in the document as well as define any uncommon terms.

children.title: Classification Marking
children.content: Documents shall be marked in accordance with the applicable classification marking, as necessary, in accordance with DoD Manual (DoDM) 5200.01, Volume 2, DoD Information Security Program: Marking of Information, or Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) markings (when applicable) in accordance with DoDI 5200.48, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). (Copies of these documents are available online at www.esd.whs.mil/DD.)
